title: PhotographyRuleSet
description: A versioned collection of rule database entries (see rule.schema.json for one entry). Markdown (docs/photography-rules.md) is normative for meaning; this JSON is normative for IDs, classes, severities, phases and threshold status. A rule that is only described in prose is NOT in this file yet: rules are added here when their phase begins and their entry is specified to implementation depth.
